architecture_invariant_observations.observation: The public surface asserts no authorization semantics; nothing on the website or in docs/legal claims that AI or the client authorizes anything. PRIVACY.md:10 and SECURITY-GUIDE describe server-side auth; consistent with 'client is never the final authorization authority'.

Password-reset link delivery is impossible in production (logging mailer, redacted in prod: mailer.ts:22-26, app.ts:123) — a stale/unrecoverable credential path with no human-facing recovery instruction; this is a support and authority-continuity gap rather than an invariant violation.

EULA/Privacy drafts are acknowledged in-product at first run while marked 'not a final legal instrument' — the human-decision authority (counsel review) has not been exercised, yet the product records acknowledgment (onboarding.ts:50-51).
